title: Add opt-in bounded output to rune run: --max-output=BYTES head+tail truncation and --tail=N, closing #12
description: Add opt-in bounded output to rune run: --max-output=BYTES head+tail truncation and --tail=N, closing #12
acceptance_criteria: rune run --max-output=BYTES truncates clean_output and raw_output to at most BYTES each, keeping head and tail and reporting truncated/omitted_bytes in the result data; rune run --tail=N keeps only the last N lines of each and reports truncated/omitted_lines; neither flag changes default output when unset; combining both flags fails with a clear error; specs/pty_runner/pty_runner.spec.md documents the new flags, invariants, and error cases; new RSpec coverage for OutputLimiter, PTYRunner, and RunCommand passes; fledge lanes run verify passes.
